Date of Discovery: May 23, 2023 (Signal Plus Messenger removal from Google Play)
Method of Attack: Trojanized IM apps containing BadBazaar spyware
Tracking device location, stealing call logs and SMS, recording phone calls, taking pictures, exfiltrating contact lists, stealing files or databases
FlyGram targets contact lists, call logs, Google Accounts, WiFi data, and sends Telegram communication data to attacker-controlled server via backup feature
Signal Plus Messenger extracts Signal communications and PIN, abuses Signal's QR-code linking feature to link victim's Signal account to attacker-controlled devices to spy on future messages
Impacted Systems: Android devices using Signal and Telegram apps
Users in Ukraine, Poland, the Netherlands, Spain, Portugal, Germany, Hong Kong, United States
Attack Vector: Trojanized apps uploaded to Google Play and Samsung Galaxy Store
Dedicated websites signalplus[.]org and flygram[.]org offering app installation links
